story_source: invented placeholder content for the generic example instance, not real session material

roles.name: Keeper of the Ledgers
points: Has worked with paper files for years
Knows every exception to the rule
roles.story: You have kept the records of a place that keeps changing for years. Every new rule crosses your desk first, before it applies anywhere else.

roles.name: Travelling Technician
points: Fixes what others have given up on
roles.story: You show up when something is broken that nobody else wants to fix. You stay only as long as the repair takes.

roles.name: Night Watch
roles.object: a flashlight with a weak battery
points: Knows every corner of the place in the dark
Trusts nobody who was here during the day
roles.story: You are here once everyone else has left. What happens at night, only you see.

roles.name: New Colleague
points: Asks the questions nobody else dares to ask anymore
roles.story: You are new to this place and notice things nobody else has noticed in a long time.

roles.name: Oversight
points: Knows every rule, even the unwritten ones
roles.story: You are responsible for keeping everything here in order. What that means in practice, you decide anew every day.
